title: Naarsingh Churna
description: Naarsingh Churna (Narasimha Churna) is a powerful classical rejuvenative formula containing iron-rich trace materials processed with nourishing herbs. This formulation restores youthful vitality by replenishing depleted mineral and nutritional reserves. Controls premature graying and hair loss through mineral nourishment and improved circulation to hair follicles. Enhances muscle strength through protein assimilation and muscle tissue nourishment. Acts as an immunomodulator strengthening immune function. The iron content makes this particularly valuable for those with low hemoglobin.
dosage: Mixed with ghee, honey, or warm milk
